text.card: A red giant 2,137 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.93 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,880 K at its surface.
